reviewed_controls.fixed_cta_label: 公式商品ページを見る（外部サイト）

blockers.finding: The fixed selection digest is compared as a constant but is not derived from or verified against the render records or click selection. Render input also permits duplicate public identifiers.

The click candidate accepts caller-supplied selection, status, timestamp, and transient URL independently. It does not establish that a fresh official observation and the transient affiliate URL belong to the clicked opaque identifier.
The offline renderer emits the opaque /go link without the required noopener, noreferrer, and sponsored rel tokens.

minimum_remediation: Derive and verify a canonical digest from the exact unique selected identifiers before render and at click evaluation.
Bind a fresh click-time official response, its resolved item identity, and its transient affiliate URL to the clicked opaque identifier; fail closed on every mismatch or unavailable state.
Render the required noopener, noreferrer, and sponsored rel tokens with the fixed CTA and proximate PR disclosure, then add regression coverage.
